name: Get transactional sender
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the details of a specific transactional sender identified by its email address. Use a list‑senders action instead if you need to enumerate all senders.
preconditions: A transactional sender with the given email must already exist.

id.description: The email address that identifies the transactional sender.

outputs.description: A map keyed by the internal sender ID containing the sender details.

from.description: The display name used as the sender.

blocked.description: Whether the sender is blocked (1) or active (0).
